invariants.text: A post can be associated with zero or more tags.
A post cannot be created without an author_id that references an existing author.
A post must be associated with exactly one author.
A tag can be associated with zero or more posts.
A tag cannot be created without a unique name.
An author must have a name and email.
Author.author_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Author.email must be a string
Author.email must not be null
Author.name must be a string
Author.name must not be null
Each post must have a title and content.
Each tag must have a unique name.
Post.author_id must be an integer
Post.author_id must not be null
Post.author_id must reference an existing Author.author_id
Post.content must be a string
Post.content must not be null
Post.post_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Post.title must be a string
Post.title must not be null
PostTag.post_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
PostTag.tag_id must be an integer
PostTag.tag_id must not be null
PostTag.tag_id must reference an existing Tag.tag_id
Tag.name must be a string
Tag.name must not be null
Tag.tag_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
The association between a post and a tag is bidirectional and must be maintained through the PostTag junction table.
When a post is searched by a tag, only posts that have that tag in their tag association are returned.
